description: Get one conversation's full message thread by id, returning its subject, participants, and every message (id, body, author_id, created_at) — not just the last_message summary list_conversations returns. Canvas marks any unread messages in this thread as read as a side effect of calling this, so re-reading a thread changes its unread state. Find the conversation_id with list_conversations. Use get_conversation_unread_count to check the inbox-wide unread total without marking anything read.
name: get_conversation
title: Get Conversation
